messages:
maya: FYI onboarding run for ranker-v2 shows a surprising MRR drop on the 'anchors' slice.

oliver: numbers?

maya: NDCG@10 0.802 -> 0.753, MRR 0.422 -> 0.364 (v1 -> v2). Overall global NDCG stable (~0.801 -> 0.798). Only anchors slice hit.

maya: We also tried int8 PTQ on v2; quant loss small global but anchors hit worse.

sanjay: Can you paste the exact eval command + preprocess config?

maya: ```
python eval.py --model=ranker-v2 --checkpoint=2026-03-10 \\n  --quant=int8 --dataset=anchors_v2 --preproc=configs/anchors_preproc.yml
# preproc keys:
# normalize_unicode: true
# normalize_spaces: true
# anchor_delimiter: "\\n\\n"
```

ana: Heads up — last week we toggled normalize_spaces globally to compress multiple spaces -> single space. That was meant for web-scrape cleanup. Could change tokenization and segment boundaries.

oliver: If compressing spaces removes anchor separators (like double newlines) or squashes tokens, scores could change.

sanjay: Check whether anchor_delimiter behaviour changed; if preprocessing removed blank lines, doc concatenation could fuse two docs leading to longer context per candidate.

maya: I ran a quick diff on tokenized queries: median token len unchanged, but 12% of anchors lost a trailing separator token. Those queries have MRR delta -0.08.

eval-bot: Automated eval summary: anchors_v2 sample (n=5k): ndcg@10 delta -0.049, mrr delta -0.058; significant p<0.01 (bootstrap).

ana: Can we re-run the exact eval with normalize_spaces=false for v2 quant and fp16 to isolate preprocess? Also include a "preserve_delimiters: true" flag.

oliver: I'll queue a small 1k ablation job: (old-preproc vs new-preproc) x (fp16 vs int8) — compare per-query NDCG and tokenization diff.

sanjay: Add a candidate-order check too — ensure we didn't change candidate shuffle seed in the bring-up job.

maya: Action items: (1) oliver run ablation 1k, (2) ana confirm preproc config changes in config repo, (3) sanjay check candidate ordering & seed in eval harness. I'll collect results and reopen thread.

ana: Confirming: I reverted normalize_spaces flag in a branch and will link PR once tests pass.

oliver: Queued: job id 20260320122. I'll post small summary when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

maya: :thumbsup: thanks — if ablation confirms preproc, we avoid a model revert.
